title: Pyrazine derivative synthesis in a continuous-flow system: a green synthesis of pyrazinamide from pyrazine esters and amines catalyzed by Lipozyme® TL IM from Thermomyces lanuginosus
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,39560-39568
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA06761D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Ao-Ying Zhang, Zong-Hao Huang, Li-Hua Du, Hang Lin, Han-Jia Xie, Bing-Lin Yan, Miao Miao Xue, Lin Wang, Wen-Xuan Shao, Guo-Neng Fu, Xi-Ping Luo
The continuous flow synthesis of a series of pyrazinamide derivatives catalyzed by Lipozyme® TL IM was successfully achieved with good scalability. A continuous production of pyrazinamide derivatives was first performed coupled with enzymes.
